currentL1.scope: one Node.js process / one warm Vercel instance

keys.evidence: namespace + engine/schema/detector/catalog/balance + username + source fingerprint + referenceDate
keys.manifest: detector + repo id + path + blob SHA

twoInstances.limitation: L1 is process-local and is not shared between instances

staleWhileRevalidate.policy: serve stale only when the caller schedules revalidation with platform-supported background work

caveat: Without shared L2, hit ratio depends on instance affinity and warm lifetime; L1 cannot satisfy a multi-instance SLA by itself.
